2024-09-20.label: Announced bank financing
2024-09-20.claim: BNP Paribas announces a financing commitment for asset-backed credit originated by Apollo and ATLAS SP.
2024-09-20.limit: The release describes a commitment. It does not establish actual drawdowns or their current status.
2024-09-20.watch: Drawdowns, maturities and changes to the agreement.

2024-09-20.label: Announced majority ownership
2024-09-20.claim: The release describes ATLAS SP as majority-owned by Apollo funds.
2024-09-20.limit: The investing funds are separate from the Apollo asset manager balance sheet. The release does not detail their individual stakes.

2026-07-29.label: Investment management mandate
2026-07-29.claim: Ares Capital Management manages ARCC under an investment advisory and management agreement.
2026-07-29.limit: The manager and the financing company are separate entities.

2026-07-29.label: Bank facility agent
2026-07-29.claim: JPMorgan is the administrative agent for the ARCC credit facility cited in exhibit 10.1.
2026-07-29.limit: Acting as agent does not mean JPMorgan provides all the lending.

2026-07-29.label: Lender and administrative agent
2026-07-29.claim: BNP Paribas is a lender and the administrative agent for the ARCC FB Funding facility.
2026-07-29.limit: The facility finances this vehicle; it does not identify a particular ultimate borrower.

2026-10-27.label: BNP facility · September 30 position
2026-10-27.claim: ARCC’s 10-Q reports $1,465 million of capacity and $733 million of principal outstanding under ARCC FB Funding’s BNP facility at September 30, 2026.
2026-10-27.limit: Capacity remains subject to the borrowing base and credit terms. The balance belongs to the financing vehicle, with no disclosed allocation to a specific ultimate borrower.

2026-07-29.label: Equity ownership and loan servicing
2026-07-29.claim: ARCC is the equity owner and loan servicer of ARCC FB Funding in exhibit 10.3.
2026-07-29.limit: The vehicle borrows separately from its parent.

2026-07-29.label: Senior secured loan
2026-07-29.claim: ARCC reports a first-lien senior secured loan to Hyland Software as of June 30, 2026.
2026-07-29.limit: One reported holding does not describe all of Hyland's debt.
2026-07-29.watch: Repayments and the next investment schedule.

2026-08-10.label: Management of the insurer's portfolio
2026-08-10.claim: Athene states that Apollo manages substantially all of its investments as of June 30, 2026.
2026-08-10.limit: This mandate does not turn the insurer's obligations into debts of Apollo-managed funds.

2026-11-05.label: Investment management · third quarter
2026-11-05.claim: Athene’s September 30, 2026 report states that Apollo manages substantially all of its investments. Services include direct investment management, asset allocation and operational support.
2026-11-05.limit: The investments and obligations remain within Athene’s insurance business. This relationship describes their management.

2026-08-10.label: Ownership of investment vehicles
2026-08-10.claim: Apollo states that Athene owns and consolidates AAA and AAA Lux, which hold alternative investments.
2026-08-10.limit: These vehicles may also include third-party capital. Accounting consolidation does not mean full ownership.
2026-08-10.watch: Ownership interests and third-party investor interests.

2026-08-10.label: Indirect equity ownership
2026-08-10.claim: Athene's equity interest in Atlas is held through its investments in AAA and AAA Lux.
2026-08-10.limit: This ownership chain is separate from the Atlas securities Athene holds directly.
2026-08-10.watch: Changes in ownership interests and scope.

2026-11-05.label: Atlas equity · indirect ownership confirmed
2026-11-05.claim: Athene confirms an equity investment in Atlas Securitized Products Holdings LP through AAA and AAA Lux at September 30, 2026.
2026-11-05.limit: The filing describes the ownership chain. It reports securities issued by Atlas affiliates separately, without quantifying this equity interest in that section.
2026-11-05.watch: Ownership breakdown across AAA, AAA Lux and Atlas.

2026-08-10.label: Investment in securities
2026-08-10.claim: Athene reports holding available-for-sale securities issued by Atlas or its affiliates as of June 30, 2026.
2026-08-10.limit: This link groups the Atlas and affiliate issuers cited in the report. It measures neither a loss nor a new flow of funds.

2026-11-05.label: Atlas affiliate securities · $6.5bn
2026-11-05.claim: Athene reports holding $6.5 billion of available-for-sale securities issued by certain Atlas affiliates at September 30, 2026.
2026-11-05.limit: This securities balance is separate from indirect equity ownership and deferred purchase price guarantees. It does not measure quarterly purchases or Pagaya financing.

2026-08-10.label: Management of funds and vehicles
2026-08-10.claim: Apollo raises and manages funds, accounts and vehicles for institutional and individual investors.
2026-08-10.limit: This node groups distinct vehicles. It represents neither a single fund nor a blanket Apollo guarantee.

2026-09-08.label: Offering announced · $750m
2026-09-08.claim: ARCC announces a $750 million principal offering with a 6.250% annual coupon, maturing on September 15, 2033. Closing is expected on September 15, 2026.
2026-09-08.limit: At this date, closing remains conditional. Principal differs from net proceeds after the discount and fees.

2026-09-15.label: Offering closed · $750m
2026-09-15.claim: ARCC confirms the September 15 closing of its $750 million principal offering. These unsecured notes carry a 6.250% coupon and mature on September 15, 2033. Net proceeds are intended to repay debt under its credit facilities.
2026-09-15.limit: Repayment remains a stated intended use. The coupon does not capture the cost after the interest rate swap with JPMorgan. No financing of a particular portfolio loan can be inferred.
2026-09-15.watch: Completed repayments and the effects of the interest rate swap.

2026-09-29.label: Announced closing · VFN warehouse
2026-09-29.claim: Pagaya announces the closing of a revolving VFN facility with ATLAS SP, targeting approximately $700 million of capacity. The structure provides for a dedicated vehicle to warehouse personal loans before securitization.
2026-09-29.limit: The release does not give the vehicle's legal name, publish the agreement or disclose drawdowns. Capacity is not confirmed cash received. No financing from BNP or Athene to this warehouse is established.
2026-09-29.watch: Vehicle identity, agreement, drawdowns and maturities.

2026-10-05.label: PAID 2026-6 · announced closing · $600m
2026-10-05.claim: Pagaya announces the closing of PAID 2026-6, a $600 million personal loan securitization.
2026-10-05.limit: An ABS is an asset-backed security. The release provides neither individual subscriptions nor an allocation of loans from the ATLAS SP VFN facility. The issuance amount does not measure a draw on that facility.
2026-10-05.watch: Issuance documents, legal issuer and loan provenance.

2026-10-12.label: RPM 2026-5 · announced closing · $650m
2026-10-12.claim: Pagaya announces the closing of RPM 2026-5, a $650 million auto loan securitization.
2026-10-12.limit: The release does not name every subscriber. This issue is distinct from PAID 2026-6 and the personal loan VFN facility; no loan transfer from that facility is established. The two investor groups are not assumed to be identical.
2026-10-12.watch: Issuance documents, legal issuer and subscription allocations.

2026-09-22.label: PAID REV1 · revolving structure
2026-09-22.claim: Pagaya announces an initial $460 million and projects approximately $850 million in deployment over 24 months through reinvestment.
2026-09-22.limit: Projected deployment is cumulative; it does not measure cash received at closing. Individual investors are not named.

reading.label: Read: insurers’ route into private credit

2026-10-22.label: Reported capital raised · $510m
2026-10-22.claim: Partners Group reports closing its second rated feeder of 2026, raising $510 million from US insurers. They subscribed to investment grade and junior notes; some also invested in equity.
2026-10-22.limit: This is the manager’s disclosure. Insurers, legal issuer, contracts and tranche allocations are not identified. The $510 million therefore represents neither debt alone nor the market’s total outstanding exposure.
2026-10-22.watch: Vehicle identity, contracts, amounts by tranche and subscribers’ rights.

reading.label: Read: insurers’ route into private credit

2026-10-22.label: Access to the evergreen strategy
2026-10-22.claim: Partners Group presents the feeder as access to its evergreen private credit strategy, which focuses on senior corporate lending. The strategy is shown collectively; the release does not give the underlying fund’s legal identity.
2026-10-22.limit: Access to a strategy does not establish investment in any particular loan. Regulatory capital benefits are the manager’s claims, without a published determination for each insurer or tranche.
2026-10-22.watch: The fund actually held, redemption terms and regulatory treatment specific to the securities.

2026-11-05.label: Guarantees of Atlas’s deferred purchase price
2026-11-05.claim: Athene describes Atlas’s $2.5 billion deferred purchase obligation to Credit Suisse for acquired assets. The stated order is Atlas, then AAA, Apollo Asset Management (AAM), Athene Holding (AHL) and Athene Annuity Re (AARe). AAM and AARe each issued a letter guaranteeing the full amount to Credit Suisse.
2026-11-05.limit: The Athene node groups AHL and AARe here. Successive guarantees cover the same obligation and are not additive. Athene considers payment under its guarantees not probable and records no liability for them.
2026-11-05.watch: Deferred price balance, investor contributions and any guarantee call.

2024-09-20.label: BNP and ATLAS SP
2024-09-20.change: An announced financing partnership and ownership by Apollo funds. This view reproduces the position described in the 2024 release.

2026-07-29.label: The Ares financing chain
2026-07-29.change: ARCC's report as of June 30, 2026 distinguishes its manager, bank facilities, financing subsidiary and a loan to Hyland Software.

2026-08-10.label: The insurance financing chain
2026-08-10.change: Apollo and Athene's reports as of June 30, 2026 describe management mandates, indirect ownership and securities holdings. Links from 2024 retain their original date.

2026-09-08.label: The bond offering
2026-09-08.change: ARCC announces a bond offering to refinance debt under its credit facilities. This release does not yet confirm completion.

2026-09-15.label: The offering closes
2026-09-15.change: The 8-K confirms the offering closed. ARCC's bond financing appears alongside its bank facilities; actual repayments remain to be documented.

2026-09-29.label: The Pagaya loan warehouse
2026-09-29.change: Pagaya announces a revolving facility with ATLAS SP to hold personal loans ahead of securitization. Target capacity and drawdowns are distinct.

2026-10-05.label: Pagaya · personal loan securitization
2026-10-05.change: PAID 2026-6 joins the map as an issue separate from the VFN facility.

2026-10-12.label: Pagaya · auto loan securitization
2026-10-12.change: RPM 2026-5 adds an auto loan issue; no funding chain between the two securitizations is inferred.

2026-09-22.label: Pagaya · PAID REV1
2026-09-22.change: A revolving structure separates initial funding from expected deployment.

2026-10-22.label: Partners Group · insurers and feeder
2026-10-22.change: The release adds a $510m vehicle and its access to the evergreen strategy. Debt notes and equity are distinguished, without applying January’s vehicle terms to the October financing.

2026-10-27.label: ARCC · third-quarter BNP facility
2026-10-27.change: The 10-Q updates BNP facility capacity and principal outstanding at September 30. Other ARCC holdings retain their earlier observations.

2026-11-05.label: Athene · Atlas securities and deferred price guarantees
2026-11-05.change: The 10-Q updates Apollo’s mandate, indirect Atlas ownership and affiliate securities at September 30. A separate relationship describes deferred price guarantees for Credit Suisse, without adding them to the securities balance.
